snippet.title: Misspell - Official Gameplay Trailer [ Indie-Credible Showcase 2026 ]
snippet.description:
Misspell is a 2D atmospheric Metroidvania about magic and mysteries of the past. Uncover the secrets of an island risen from the ashes of a catastrophe and master a magical living vine that changes the way you fight and explore. Every step tells a story - every enemy echoes the mistakes of the past.

Official Steampage:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3235850/Misspell/

This trailer is part of the Indie-Credible - Indie Game Showcase 2026:
